# Wolf Sight

Internal ID: TrinketSilverDamage | Type: Trinkets | Source: Forge | Crafting Materials: Silver x5, Wolf fang x5, Fenring trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 55 | Effect: +20 Bows skill | +20 Spears skill | +10% pierce damage | Duration: 30s

# Introduction

Wolf Sight is a Mountain-tier trinket.

## Effects

Once 55 Adrenaline has been gained, the Wolf Sight will trigger automatically, providing +20 Bows skill, +20 Spears skill, and +10% Pierce damage for 30 seconds.

Categorias: Trinket
